import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int next, to, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge(int next, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static final int MAXN = 100010;
    static final int MAXM = 2000020;
    static final long INF = 1000000000L;

    static Edge[] e = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] hd = new int[MAXN];
    static int ecnt = 1;
    static int node_cnt;
    static List<Integer>[] g = new List[MAXN];

    static void link(int u, int v, int cap, long cost) {
        e[++ecnt] = new Edge(hd[u], v, cap, cost);
        hd[u] = ecnt;
        e[++ecnt] = new Edge(hd[v], u, 0, -cost);
        hd[v] = ecnt;
    }

    static class MCF {
        static int[] cur;
        static boolean[] vis;
        static long[] dist;
        static long[] pot;

        static class State implements Comparable<State> {
            int id;
            long key;
            State(int i, long k) {
                id = i;
                key = k;
            }
            public int compareTo(State o) {
                return Long.compare(key, o.key);
            }
        }

        static PriorityQueue<State> heap;

        static boolean spfa(int src, int dst, int nodeCount) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            for (int i = 1; i <= nodeCount; i++) {
                cur[i] = hd[i];
            }
            dist[dst] = 0;
            heap = new PriorityQueue<>();
            heap.offer(new State(dst, 0));

            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                int u = heap.poll().id;
                if (vis[u]) continue;
                vis[u] = true;

                for (int i = hd[u]; i != 0; i = e[i].next) {
                    int v = e[i].to;
                    long w = pot[u] + e[i ^ 1].cost - pot[v];
                    if (e[i ^ 1].cap > 0 && dist[u] + w < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        heap.offer(new State(v, dist[v]));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i <= nodeCount; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(pot[i] + dist[i], INF);
            }

            if (!vis[src]) return false;
            Arrays.fill(vis, 1, nodeCount + 1, false);
            return true;
        }

        static int dfs(int u, int dst, int flow) {
            if (u == dst || flow == 0) return flow;
            int pushed = 0;
            vis[u] = true;

            for (int i = cur[u]; i != 0; i = e[i].next) {
                cur[u] = i;
                if (e[i].cap > 0) {
                    int v = e[i].to;
                    int f;
                    if (!vis[v] && pot[v] + e[i].cost == pot[u] &&
                        (f = dfs(v, dst, Math.min(flow, e[i].cap))) > 0) {
                        e[i].cap -= f;
                        e[i ^ 1].cap += f;
                        pushed += f;
                        flow -= f;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }

            vis[u] = false;
            return pushed;
        }

        static int total_flow;
        static long total_cost;

        static void run(int src, int dst, int nodeCount) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            while (spfa(src, dst, nodeCount)) {
                int f = dfs(src, dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                total_flow += f;
                total_cost += (long) f * pot[src];
            }
        }
    }

    static int src = 1, dst = 2, n, m, k, c, d;

    static int idx(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void layer(int t) {
        node_cnt += n;

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
            for (int v : g[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; p++) {
                    link(idx(t, u), idx(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2L * p - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; u++) {
            link(idx(t, u), idx(t + 1, u), Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        link(idx(t + 1, 1), dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c * (t + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        node_cnt = n + 2;

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            link(src, idx(0, a), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            g[u].add(v);
            g[v].add(u);
        }

        link(idx(0, 1), dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; i++) {
            layer(i);
        }

        MCF.cur = new int[MAXN];
        MCF.vis = new boolean[MAXN];
        MCF.dist = new long[MAXN];
        MCF.pot = new long[MAXN];

        MCF.run(src, dst, node_cnt);
        System.out.println(MCF.total_cost);
    }
}
